subject: Culture
title: Famine as Weapon
description: A quick, practical guide to Famine as Weapon.

hook.text: The Holodomor killed millions of Ukrainians in 1932. Stalin engineered a famine to crush resistance.

buildup.text: Throughout history, armies have burned crops to starve enemies. Food denial is war's oldest tactic.

discovery.text: The British exported food from Ireland during the Great Famine. A million died while ships carried grain away.

twist.text: Modern sieges still use starvation. Aid blockades turn food into a geopolitical tool.

climax.text: Controlling food supply controls populations. Whoever holds the harvest holds the power.

punchline.text: Hunger has always been a political weapon.

quiz.question: What was the Holodomor?
options: A man-made famine in Ukraine engineered by Stalin
